dependency_graph: T1 -> T2 for any tests or interfaces that consume T1 output
T1 -> T3 only if resumable workflow consumes T1 status schema; otherwise T3 may proceed independently after contract freeze
T1 + T2 + T3 -> T4 final integration and evidence
T4 -> no source mutation outside its explicit allowlist
handoff_controls: handoff and ready are immutable once emitted
files list uses exact repository-relative paths plus SHA-256
artifacts list uses absolute path plus SHA-256
needs_fix/needs_input/blocked remains a real state, never upgraded by timeout
T4 verifies source bytes and handoff bytes immediately before copying and again before final evidence

proposed_ownership.T1: PDF crash recovery/status implementation and its tests/evidence only
proposed_ownership.T2: import/live-integrity and selected-paper retrieval tests/evidence only; may consume only frozen T1 handoff
proposed_ownership.T3: resumable workflow and Skills paths only; no T1/T2 source or shared packet edits
proposed_ownership.T4: CLI/docs and final integration evidence only; immutable allowlisted copies from stopped T1/T2/T3 handoffs

risks: Packet absence currently prevents exact path-overlap review
T3 Skills may touch shared documentation or fixtures unless the packet names narrow paths
T4 could accidentally reintroduce source/tests from an unallowlisted copy unless it verifies every received path and rejects extras
T2 selected-paper retrieval can drift into external-data/network use unless fixtures and offline limits are explicit
ownership_and_dependency_review.sufficiency: Conditionally sufficient if T1/T2/T3 write disjoint paths and T4 receives frozen SHA-addressed handoffs. T2 must not guess T1 interfaces; T4 must not copy directories or accept moving ready files.

packet_review.finding: The new contract/COMMON/TERMINAL packet files were absent at observation time. Exact allowlisted paths, handoff schema, packet hash, and revision-specific dependencies cannot be independently approved until they appear.
required_before_start: handoff/ready required fields and stopped_writing rule

permission_limits: No Git branch switching, reset, clean, commit, push, fetch, PR, merge, or remote CI in this review.
No real Vault mutation, vpwiki-admin execution, operator approval, model download, dependency installation, or network access.
Use only disposable fixture Vaults and short-lived temporary directories; do not use the user PDF as a test oracle unless the packet explicitly permits read-only fixture access.
Keep 67 catalog/overlay entries, inbox, tools, plans, and historical evidence unchanged.
Keep shared .venv read-only and run one explicit Python executable per targeted lane.

runtime_protection.temp_policy: Use a short-lived /private/tmp/vpwiki.* directory for --basetemp and pytest cache; no repository cache writes.
runtime_protection.wheel_policy: Reuse an already prepared isolated wheel Python only after candidate evidence is frozen; do not install or rebuild during this review.

targeted_validation_plan.T3: PYTHONPATH="$T3/src" "$PYTHON" -B -m pytest -q --basetemp "$TMP/pytest" -o cache_dir="$TMP/cache" tests/research/test_writing.py tests/closure/test_installed_skills.py tests/closure/test_closure_cli_exact.py tests/security/test_cli_isolation.py
